in-county-government.summary: In 37 counties the map has no county council district lines, so it cannot say which council seat is yours; the County card lists every member.
in-county-government.why: This app draws the council districts counties give the state's mapping office, and these counties gave none or only part. Lake and St. Joseph also elect commissioners by district, and those lines are missing too.
in-county-government.wanted: The county council district covering the point in every county, and the commissioner district in Lake and St. Joseph counties.

in-court-of-appeals-judges.area: Indiana — the Court of Appeals' 1st, 2nd and 3rd Districts
in-court-of-appeals-judges.summary: Your Court of Appeals District card says which district you are in and how its judges are chosen and kept, and names none of its three judges yet.
in-court-of-appeals-judges.why: The court publishes its fifteen judges, and this app does not yet read which district each one comes from.
in-court-of-appeals-judges.wanted: Nothing from a reader — this one is ours to build.

in-general-assembly-roster.summary: Both General Assembly cards name your district and link the chamber's directory instead of naming your senator or representative.
in-general-assembly-roster.why: This app has not yet fetched a roster for either chamber, so it sends you to the General Assembly's own member list rather than printing a name it cannot check.
in-general-assembly-roster.wanted: The senator and representative holding each of the 50 Senate and 100 House districts.

in-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City or Town card names the mayor and council only in places over 25,000 people, and not which council seat is yours.
in-municipal-officeholders.why: This app names the councils of Indiana's largest places so far, from the state's election results and three towns' own pages. Council district lines are not on the map, so the card lists every seat.
in-municipal-officeholders.wanted: The mayor or town council president, the council members and the clerk of each city and town, and the council district covering the point.

in-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district and none of the board members who run it.
in-school-board-members.why: Indiana elects most school board members, but this app has no roster of them and no map of the seats that are elected by district, so it names the district only.
in-school-board-members.wanted: The board members of each district, and the sub-district boundaries where a seat is elected by one.

in-township-officers.summary: The Township card names the trustee and board most townships elected in 2022, but in 97 townships it names only part of that, or nobody.
in-township-officers.why: The names come from the state's certified 2022 election results, and some townships had no trustee or board race in them, including all nine in Marion County. They are election winners, so someone appointed since then is not shown.
in-township-officers.wanted: The trustee and every board member of each township, including Marion County's five-member boards, and the assessor where a township elects one.
